en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large waterfront hotel building in neoclassical style, with arcades and balconies, seen from across the water. Small boats are on the water in front of the building. The bottom margin contains printed Greek and French/English text identifying the scene as the Mediterranean Palace in Salonique (Thessaloniki), along with a publisher credit and reference number.
